pages.title: Gravity Glitch
pages.creator: Sharr Studios
pages.description: Flip between the floor and ceiling in Gravity Glitch to dodge spikes, pits and saws. Learn how rings and gates affect your route as you run through 30 levels across three neon worlds.

pages.title: Arrow Sand Puzzle
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description: Release arrows with a clear path in Arrow Sand Puzzle and watch them turn into streams of sand. Match the sand to its bucket and plan ahead so the conveyor doesn't fill up.

pages.title: Yummy Tales 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Help Oscar feed the farm animals in Yummy Tales 4. Swap fruit, vegetables and treats to make matches, and focus on the ingredients each level asks you to collect.

pages.title: Pixel Journey
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Explore a pixel world and gather resources in Pixel Journey. Look around as you move through each new area and follow the route to the end to discover the world's secrets.

pages.title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Shoot bubbles into groups of the same color in Bublix: Bubble Hit. Bounce a shot off the wall to reach tricky spots and set up combos as the endless board gets harder.

pages.title: Lost Adventure
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Guide a pilot through unfamiliar land after a plane crash in Lost Adventure. Gather resources, make tools and solve puzzles to find the passengers scattered across the area.

pages.title: Happy Blocks
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Make room for incoming shapes in Happy Blocks by fitting pieces together on the board. Plan placements that clear space and leave useful openings for the shapes you get next.

pages.title: Block LEGENDS!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Fill a row or column to clear it in Block LEGENDS! Drag the pieces into useful gaps and see whether the cleared lines uncover diamonds, bombs or score multipliers.

pages.title: Sticker Jam Peel Off & Match
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Peel colorful stickers and sort them into matches in Sticker Jam Peel Off & Match. Work out which stickers you can reach first and keep the colors organized as the arrangement changes.

pages.title: The Last Tiger: Tank Simulator
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Command a World War II Tiger tank in The Last Tiger: Tank Simulator. Drive into position, aim at opposing vehicles and work through the missions while keeping your own tank in the fight.

pages.title: Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Visit the BerryWorks cafeteria in Strawberry Shortcake BoardGames. Choose checkers, tic-tac-toe, memory, connecting pairs or a jigsaw, and switch activities whenever you're ready for a different kind of puzzle.

pages.title: Vega Mix: Sea Adventures
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Make matches of three as you explore underwater in Vega Mix: Sea Adventures. Work through puzzle boards as the heroes search a sunken ship and discover more of an ancient city.

pages.title: My Little City
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Prepare plots for construction in My Little City by completing match-three puzzles. Line up building supplies and pay attention to what the city council needs on each job.

pages.title: PopCats: Merge the cats!
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Combine two identical cats to get a larger cat in PopCats: Merge the cats! Keep making room for the growing collection and try to bring the two biggest cats together to win.

pages.title: College Girls Team Makeover
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style five friends in College Girls Team Makeover. Try clothes and accessories on each girl and decide whether to give the group coordinated looks or a different style for everyone.

pages.title: My Pocket Blacksmith
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Work the forge to the beat in My Pocket Blacksmith. Time your actions to the rhythm while you make equipment and explore the medieval fantasy setting around the workshop.

pages.title: Jigsaw Casual
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose a picture and put the scattered pieces together in Jigsaw Casual. Change the difficulty when you want a different challenge and work through puzzles to unlock more images.

pages.title: Breakout Champion
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bounce a ball off the paddle in Breakout Champion to break descending rows of bricks. Adjust your returns to reach the remaining bricks before they move past your boundary.

pages.title: Wugy HalloweenTower War
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Move heroes into battles in Wugy HalloweenTower War. Pick where to send them as you explore the map, defeat the monsters guarding each area and unlock powers for later challenges.

pages.title: Impossible Monster Truck race Monster Truck Games 2021
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description: Take a monster truck onto extreme stunt tracks in Impossible Monster Truck race. Manage your speed on narrow stretches and line up each jump to keep the truck on the course.

pages.title: Parkour Block 4
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Run and jump across first-person platforming stages in Parkour Block 4. Try to beat your time in speedrun mode, or take on hardcore mode for a tougher route through the levels.

pages.title: Tile Match Fun
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Find matching shapes in Tile Match Fun and keep the level goal in view as you play. Clear the pieces you need to move on and see what score you can make.

pages.title: Super Bomb Bugs
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Recover gems and artifacts in Super Bomb Bugs while solving platform puzzles and fighting enemies. Change suits for abilities such as the dragon's fireballs or the ninja's wall jump and sticky bombs.

pages.title: Zombie Last Castle 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Hold off stronger waves of zombies in Zombie Last Castle 3. Defend the base alone or team up with another player or two to cover more ground as enemies approach.

pages.title: Mine Shooter
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Defend MineWorld in Mine Shooter using weapons from pistols to grenade launchers. Stop creepers before they explode and watch for skeletons and stone golems as you change weapons to meet each threat.

pages.title: Fish Soccer
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Play a football match underwater in Fish Soccer. Choose a side and move the ball past the opposing fish, with smaller fish helping out and a two-player mode for a friend.

pages.title: Squid Fighter
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Pick a fighter and trade punches and kicks in Squid Fighter. Use each player's separate controls to take on a friend and find openings for the bonus move.

pages.title: Math Memory
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Turn over cards in Math Memory and look for pairs that go together. Work through addition, subtraction, multiplication and division as you find the matches hidden among the sixteen cards.

pages.title: Find It Out
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Search each scene for the objects listed in Find It Out. Scan the picture in sections and look closely at small details when you have only a few things left to find.

pages.title: Wheelie Buddy
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Lift the front wheel and try to carry a wheelie to the finish in Wheelie Buddy. Balance the vehicle so the front wheel stays off the ground, and use it to pick up coins.

pages.title: Crazy Little Eights
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Empty your hand in Crazy Little Eights by matching the rank or suit of the top card. Play an eight when you want to change the suit and steer the round in a new direction.

pages.title: Halloween Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Link identical Halloween pictures in Halloween Mahjong Connection. The path can turn at most twice, so remove pairs that open routes to pieces you can't connect yet.

pages.title: Touch Down
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Train a football player to improve their stats in Touch Down. Build up your salary, unlock bonuses and power-ups, and play the daily bowl game to collect your earnings.

pages.title: Love Tester
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Enter two names in Love Tester to see the compatibility result the game gives the pair. Try different combinations and compare the scores for friends or favorite fictional couples.

pages.title: Moto Bike Attack Race Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race motorcycles and knock rivals off their bikes in Moto Bike Attack Race Master. Pick up weapons when they appear and watch the road as you decide when to swing at another racer.

pages.title: Kid Pumpkin
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Collect coins through twelve platforming levels in Kid Pumpkin. Time jumps around obstacles and deal with the different enemies, including red ones you can defeat by landing on their heads.

pages.title: Star Battles
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Change your speed around an orbit in Star Battles to avoid ships and asteroids. Fire when the crosshair becomes available and unlock better spacecraft as you keep playing.

pages.title: Drop Food Chick
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Move a hungry little chicken under the falling food in Drop Food Chick. Switch quickly from left to right to catch as much as you can before the food hits the ground.

pages.title: Floating Water Bus Racing Game 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Steer a bus across open water in Floating Water Bus Racing Game 3D. Learn how the coach handles afloat and guide it along the course as if it were a racing boat.

pages.title: BTS Christmas Cookies Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture of a holiday cookie in BTS Christmas Cookies Coloring. Pick colors for the icing and decorations and give each sweet a design of your own.

pages.title: 3 in 1 Puzzle Game
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Choose among Cray Number, Merge Plus and Line Connect in 3 in 1 Puzzle Game. Switch between number puzzles and a line-drawing challenge when you want to try a different set of rules.

pages.title: Crazy Truck Parking
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a truck into a marked space in Crazy Truck Parking. Check the clearance around other vehicles and obstacles, then line up the truck carefully before making the final move.

pages.title: Halloween
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Match groups of three or more identical spooky pieces in Halloween. Look at how each move changes the board and use the new arrangement to find your next match.

pages.title: Blast Away Ball Drop
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Slide your tank left and right in Blast Away Ball Drop and shoot the balls falling into its path. Collect coins to upgrade your firepower or change the tank's appearance.

pages.title: Huracan Evo Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures of the Lamborghini in Huracan Evo Puzzle. Reassemble the car and its surroundings with a 16-piece layout or try one of the larger boards.

pages.title: EG Stick Soldier
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Hold down to grow a stick long enough to cross the gap in EG Stick Soldier. Judge the distance to the next platform, then release so the soldier can walk over.

pages.title: Biggest Gum
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Hold the screen to blow a bubble in Biggest Gum. Watch how large it gets and let go at the right size before it bursts and spoils the attempt.

pages.title: BTS Monkey Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color pictures of monkeys in BTS Monkey Coloring. Choose a drawing, try different colors on the animals and their surroundings, and make each page look the way you want.

pages.title: Mountain Bike
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Race a mountain bike downhill in Mountain Bike. Ride over rocks and roots, carry speed into jumps and watch your energy as you try to cover more distance for points.

pages.title: Air Hockey
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drag your paddle to defend your goal and knock the puck across the table in Air Hockey. Play against the clock or try to reach the target score first.

pages.title: Slenderman Must Die: DEAD SPACE
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned station for thirteen energy cells in Slenderman Must Die: DEAD SPACE. Gather what your stranded ship needs to run again while watching for danger in the station.

pages.title: My Casual Life Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Put together a casual outfit in My Casual Life Dressup. Try leggings, jeans or sweaters, then choose accessories to give the finished everyday look the style you want.

pages.title: Slime Rush TD
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Place towers along the approach to the kingdom in Slime Rush TD. Cover the route to the gate and make each placement count as larger groups of slimes march in.

pages.title: Quick Math
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Spot the correct calculation and tap it quickly in Quick Math. Keep choosing the right result as the arithmetic problems appear, and try to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Ariel And Eric Wedding
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search for hidden objects under the sea to help Eric free Ariel in Ariel And Eric Wedding. Find the keys to open her cage so the couple can reach their ceremony.

pages.title: Jumbled.io
pages.creator: Electronauts
pages.description: Drag the right letters from the jumble into the answer slots in Jumbled.io. Build a streak for more points and watch out for other players interfering with your letters.

pages.title: Zombie Arena 3D Survival Offline
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fight computer-controlled zombies across pixel-style maps in Zombie Arena 3D Survival Offline. Try different modes and missions and keep moving when the undead start to close around you.

pages.title: Romantic Date Issues
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two mermaid princesses in Romantic Date Issues. Pick a look for each of them as they get ready for a date that turns out to be with the same person.

pages.title: Crazy Pig Simulator
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Play a runaway farm pig settling into city life in Crazy Pig Simulator. Follow an old friend's lead and charge around the streets breaking the objects you find.

pages.title: Solitaire Deluxe
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear card layouts in Solitaire Deluxe by organizing cards according to the rules of the current game. Try the different modes and look for moves that free up more cards.

pages.title: 50 50 Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give Lisa two hair colors in 50 50 Hairstyles. Pick a different shade for each side and work through the styling steps to finish her look for the summer.

pages.title: Amoebas Life
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Move through a microscopic world in Amoebas Life. Eat cells that are smaller than you to grow, and steer clear of larger enemies while you look for your next meal.

pages.title: Frogtastic
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Aim the frog's shots into the moving chain in Frogtastic. Match colors to remove balls, set up combos and stop the chain from reaching the end across 13 levels.

pages.title: Cat Ninja
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Clear enemies from each stage in Cat Ninja. Guide the cat through the level, deal with the adversaries you encounter, and make your way to the exit when the path is clear.

pages.title: Exit Isol8
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Explore a silent space station in Exit Isol8. Move from room to room to investigate what happened there, uncover its secrets and find a way back to your ship.

pages.title: Mommy and Baby Tiger
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Give the mother tiger and her cub new looks in Mommy and Baby Tiger. Change their fur colors and patterns, then try clothes and accessories for each of them.

pages.title: Preganat Kitty Room Decor
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Prepare a nursery for Angela's baby in Preganat Kitty Room Decor. Choose the room's furniture and decorations and arrange them to give the kitten a place of her own.

pages.title: Royal Wedding
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Find the things you need before the ceremony in Royal Wedding. Once you have the essentials, choose a wedding outfit and pair it with shoes and accessories.

pages.title: Princesses Winter Spree
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Put together winter looks for Elsa, Ariel and Cinderella in Princesses Winter Spree. Visit each princess during her vacation and try outfits that suit the activities she has planned.
